items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee only confirms the name 'Uncle Henry' in response to the interviewer's story about Truck Param, but does not describe any personal interaction or relationship with Truck Param himself.

ctx.x: house there in Philadelphia. It was a mainstay of the places for the bandleaders to stay. I was talking to Basie about it many times.

Well John Collins tells the story about Truck Param. He said that he was on the road with Truck and he said they were in some place in Ohio, Mr. Henry‟s is the name of the guy‟s place and at Mr. Henry‟s you pitch „til you win.
